headline: GOLD SETTLES $4,066 INTO THE MOST EVENT-DENSE MINING WEEK OF Q3 — COT SPECS TRIM TO SIX-WEEK LOWS AS HIKE ODDS CLIMB TO 37.9%
snippet: Gold settled Friday July 25 at $4,066/oz and silver at approximately $58.50 as the most event-dense stretch in Q3 mining approaches. The CFTC Commitments of Traders report released Friday July 24 showed speculative net long positions in gold falling to 183.9K contracts — a six-week low, down from 186.7K the prior week — as CME FedWatch rate-hike probability for July 29 climbed to approximately 37.9%. Four catalysts converge July 28-31: the BC Supreme Court approves the Equinox-Orla combination Monday July 28 (deal closes July 31), the Federal Reserve announces its rate decision Tuesday July 29, Agnico Eagle releases Q2 results after market close Tuesday July 29 (with Barnat Pit production updates expected to confirm full-year guidance at the lower end, ~3.3M oz), and Cameco reports Q2 on Thursday July 31. The COT de-risking signal is mild — a 2.8K contract trim rather than the capitulation flush typically seen before major reversals — suggesting specs are hedging rather than exiting their gold positions ahead of the binary decision. For retail mining investors, the gold-silver ratio at 70:1 frames the asymmetric payoff: a hold releases silver's industrial premium into a market running its sixth consecutive annual supply deficit; a hike compresses silver further but from a historically depressed base. Silver at $58.50 against a 70:1 ratio implies $81/oz at ratio normalization to its historical 50:1 average — a 38% gain without any gold move required.

headline: MCFARLANE LAKE DRILLS 179m AT 0.87 g/t GOLD AT JUBY — ONTARIO ABITIBI SYSTEM EXTENDS TO 1.9 KM AS RESOURCE UPDATE NEARS (CSE: MLM)
snippet: McFarlane Lake Mining Limited (CSE: MLM) released July 23 drill results from its 100%-owned Juby Gold Project in Ontario's Abitibi Greenstone Belt showing significant strike extension ahead of a resource update. Hole GL26-87 cut 179 metres grading 0.87 g/t gold from 34m depth, including 6.9 metres at 2.33 g/t gold; a companion hole returned 155 metres at 0.9 g/t gold. The broader program has extended the strike length of Juby's gold mineralization from 0.75 km to 1.9 km — a 2.5x expansion of the mineralized footprint. The project currently hosts 1.01 million oz indicated at 0.98 g/t and 3.17 million oz inferred at 0.89 g/t under NI 43-101. These long, consistent intercepts at grades above typical open-pit breakeven thresholds are the input the company needs to support an MRE update and advance to a preliminary economic assessment. At $4,066 gold, the economics on a 4+ million ounce Abitibi deposit at sub-$1,000/oz discovery-stage valuations represent a material disconnect from the senior producer margins being reported in Q2 earnings this week — Teck at 61% EBITDA margins, Freeport at $4.27/lb net copper margins — that has historically closed as development risk decreases and resource confidence increases.

headline: INDEPENDENCE GOLD DISCOVERS SECOND BLIND VEIN AT 3Ts PROJECT —
RETURNS 14.70 g/t Au OVER 9.10m IN BC, 250m FROM KNOWN SYSTEM (TSXV: IGO)
snippet: Independence Gold Corp. (TSXV: IGO) announced July 22 the discovery of the Goofy Vein — a new blind gold-silver structure 250 metres west of the established Ted-Mint Vein System — at its 100%-owned 3Ts Gold Project in BC's Nechako Plateau (185 km southwest of Prince George). Drill hole 3TS-26-39 returned 9.10 metres grading 14.70 g/t gold and 36.70 g/t silver (true width approximately 7.00m), with the target generated by the company's structural exploration model combined with coincident thorium anomalies from a 2025 airborne radiometric survey. The Goofy Vein is the second blind vein discovery from this same targeting methodology — the first was the Balrog discovery announced June 29, 2026. Two blind vein discoveries from one systematic algorithm is a reproducibility signal that distinguishes this from luck: the structural model is proving predictive. The 3Ts Project covers 35,486 hectares; the ability to systematically generate blind discovery targets across a district-scale claim block increases the potential for a multi-vein, multi-target resource estimate that cannot be built from a single known structure alone.

headline: SILVER X EXPANDS RED SILVER DRILL PROGRAM 5X TO 6,650m — PERU VEIN RETURNS 735 g/t Ag OVER 65m OF UNDERGROUND STRIKE (TSXV: AGX)
source_name: Investing News Network / Silver X Mining Corp.
snippet: Silver X Mining Corp. (TSXV: AGX) announced July 22 that underground diamond drilling is underway at the Red Silver Project (María Luz sector) within its flagship Nueva Recuperada Silver-Zinc-Lead Mine in Huancavelica, Peru, with the initial 1,200-metre drill program expanded more than five-fold to 6,650 metres following exceptionally high-grade underground channel sampling. The Silvia Vein returned 735 g/t Ag over 65 metres of strike and 649 g/t Ag over 40 metres of strike — two of the highest-grade channel sampling intervals at a developed silver property in Peru. The expanded program's dual objective: grow the current NI 43-101 Mineral Resource in new areas and convert inferred to measured and indicated where supported by drilling ahead of a resource update. For junior silver investors tracking the space during silver's sixth consecutive annual supply deficit (46.3M oz per the Silver Institute), the combination of a producing mine base and high-grade new discovery at the same project is one of the cleaner risk-adjusted silver setups on the TSX-V: a producing asset floors valuation while the new zone provides exploration optionality at zero incremental capital cost.

headline: NTH CYCLE'S $585M SPAC LISTS U.S. DOMESTIC COBALT-NICKEL REFINER ON NYSE — TRAFIGURA'S $1.1B OFF-TAKE BACKS FIRST DOMESTIC CRITICAL MINERAL REFINERY TO GO PUBLIC
snippet: Nth Cycle Inc. — operator of the first U.S. refinery producing high-purity nickel-cobalt mixed hydroxide product from recycled battery feedstock — announced July 22 a definitive business combination with Kensington Capital Acquisition Corp. VI (NYSE: KCAC.VI) that will list Nth Cycle Holdings on the NYSE under the ticker 'NTH' at an enterprise value of approximately $585 million. The transaction provides up to $230 million from Kensington's trust plus up to $100 million in PIPE financing with $40 million already committed. The commercial anchor: a 10-year off-take term sheet with Trafigura valued at approximately $1.1 billion. Nth Cycle's 'Oyster' modular electro-extraction system co-locates with battery recyclers, miners, and manufacturers to convert scrap and waste into high-purity nickel, cobalt, copper, and rare earths — a mine-free model for domestic critical mineral supply chain closure. For junior battery metals investors, the $585 million enterprise value assigned by institutional capital to a pre-revenue critical mineral refiner is a structural validation signal: the IRA, critical minerals executive orders, and EU CRM Act are creating investable downstream demand that doesn't depend on new mine construction timelines. Deal close expected Q4 2026.

headline: GROUP ELEVEN DRILLS NEW ZINC-LEAD ZONE 550m BEYOND STONEPARK RESOURCE IN IRELAND — 21.7% Zn+Pb INTERCEPT; 12,800m CAMPAIGN TO FOLLOW (TSXV: ZNG)
source_name: Investing News Network / Group Eleven Resources
snippet: Group Eleven Resources Corp. (TSXV: ZNG) announced July 23 a new zone of high-grade zinc-lead-silver-germanium mineralization at its 78.62%-interest Stonepark Project in County Limerick, Ireland, drilled 550 metres beyond the edge of the existing Stonepark Mineral Resource Estimate in previously untested ground — the most significant step-out from established resources in the project's history. The discovery hole intersected 6.3 metres at 4.10% zinc + lead, including 2.8 metres at 8.30% Zn+Pb and an exceptional 1.0-metre interval grading 21.7% Zn+Pb with 4 g/t silver. Group Eleven characterises this as the most significant progress at Stonepark since acquiring the licence block in 2017. The 550-metre corridor between the new zone and the existing resource boundary is now the primary target for a 12,800-metre drill program expected to begin late 2026 or early 2027. Stonepark sits 20 km from Group Eleven's Ballywire discovery at the PG West Project; Ireland's Leinster zinc district remains one of Europe's most mining-friendly base metals jurisdictions, and high-grade zinc-lead-germanium in the same belt as Glencore's historic Lisheen mine attracts a different class of institutional buyer than a greenfield discovery in a first-time mining region.

headline: NEXGOLD ADVANCES GOLDBORO TOWARD FID WITH 40,000m INFILL DRILL — FULLY PERMITTED NOVA SCOTIA GOLD PROJECT TARGETS EARLY WORKS CONSTRUCTION H2 2026 (TSXV: NEXG)
snippet: NexGold Mining Corp. (TSXV: NEXG; OTCQX: NXGCF) confirmed July 22 that its 40,000-metre reverse-circulation infill drill program is underway at the fully permitted Goldboro Gold Project in Nova Scotia, with initial results showing positive grade continuity in the first-year production ore envelope. The company simultaneously advanced detailed engineering, long-lead equipment procurement, and project financing arrangements toward a Final Investment Decision and early works construction program expected in H2 2026. Goldboro is one of the most advanced fully permitted gold development projects in Atlantic Canada — an asset class that carries a meaningful regulatory risk premium in normal market conditions, which the company's existing permits and environmental approvals eliminate. At $4,066 gold, the gap between fully permitted, construction-ready gold project valuations and the NAV that same gold would command at production is at its widest in years. A positive FID with a construction start triggers the NAV discount compression phase, which has historically been one of the most reliable return periods in the mining equity lifecycle.

headline: SOLAR IS USING 19% LESS SILVER AND THE DEFICIT IS GETTING WORSE — GOLDSILVER.COM EXPLAINS WHY THRIFTING IS BULLISH, NOT BEARISH
snippet: GoldSilver.com's analysis of the 2026 silver market draws a critical distinction between solar 'thrifting' — applying thinner silver paste layers per cell, recovering more silver per gram used — and full copper substitution, arguing these are not the same threat to silver demand and that conflating them has led investors to underestimate silver's structural supply deficit. Photovoltaic silver consumption fell 19% in 2026 to approximately 151 million ounces (from 186.6 million in 2025), the largest single-year reduction on record. Yet the sixth consecutive annual supply deficit widened to 46.3 million ounces — larger than the 40.3-million-ounce 2025 shortfall — because total silver supply also contracted approximately 2%. The structural conclusion: thrifting reduces the rate of demand growth but does not generate a surplus; it is silver mining supply that is failing to keep pace, not solar demand that is disappearing. Longi's July 9 activation of a 21 GW copper-metallized back-contact production line represents the first large commercial test of genuine substitution, but BC cells account for less than 8% of global PV production and copper-based contacts remain technically unproven at scale for the dominant TOPCon architecture. The article frames the current 70:1 gold-silver ratio and sub-$60 silver price as a market mispricing the substitution risk timeline — which remains years away for meaningful impact — while ignoring the sixth deficit in six years.

headline: U.S. RARE EARTH STOCKS SURGED 81% IN H1 2026 BEFORE GIVING BACK 20% — THREE CATALYSTS THAT COULD EXTEND THE RALLY, THREE THAT THREATEN IT
snippet: A July 2026 analysis from NAI 500 documents the 81% average surge in U.S. rare earth stocks during H1 2026, led by U.S. Rare Earths Corporation (USAR) which saw shares jump more than 80% before giving back over 20% since June 30, illustrating the sector's acute sensitivity to sentiment swings on a thin liquidity base. Three catalysts driving the H1 rally: (1) MOFCOM export licensing tightening in Q2 2026 ratcheting supply anxiety to multi-year highs; (2) NdPr alloy printing above $133/kg, a new 2026 record; (3) U.S. government grant funding and Department of Defense backing for domestic supply chain development projects. Three risks to extension: volatile equity liquidity in a sector where one institutional sell can move prices 10%+; western rare earth mine-to-market timelines of 10-15 years even with capital available; and China's 92%+ control of refined NdPr and 98%+ control of separated heavy rare earths (dysprosium, terbium) meaning that supply security for western manufacturers remains a structural challenge that current stock prices cannot resolve. For TSX-V and ASX junior rare earth developers with high NdPr ratios and projects in stable jurisdictions, the H1 surge signals institutional willingness to pay a control premium for supply security — the key near-term distinction between projects that attract capital and those that don't.

headline: DISCOVERY MINING CONFIRMS PAMOUR AT 3.7 MILLION OUNCES — 47-HOLE CAMPAIGN VALIDATES 4 KM ONTARIO GOLD SYSTEM; SHARES JUMP 8.1% (TSX: DSV)
snippet: Discovery Mining Ltd. (TSX: DSV) reported July 21 that 47 drill holes totalling 11,003 metres across four target areas — the Pamour pit, North Contact Zone, Pamour West, and Keora Trend — confirmed and expanded the mineral resource at the Pamour Mine in Ontario, with the total system now standing at 64.8 million tonnes at 1.30 g/t (2.70 million oz indicated) plus 23.3 million tonnes at 1.34 g/t (1.00 million oz inferred) for approximately 3.7 million ounces across a 4.0 km strike length. Multiple new high-grade targets outside the current open-pit mine plan were intersected. Shares rose 8.1% on the announcement. The company has acquired the Kidd Metallurgical Site to support planned milling capacity expansion following the resource confirmation — a capital investment that only makes economic sense if the operator has conviction in the deposit scale. For Ontario gold investors, the 4.0 km system at consistent grades above open-pit cutoff thresholds, combined with proximity to established Timmins district infrastructure, is the type of large-scale bulk tonnage confirmation that anchors a multi-year development pathway at $4,000+ gold.
